name: Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin for Service Businesses – Booktics
author: Arraytics

sections.description:
Introducing Booktics, the most powerful free online booking plugin for WordPress! 🚀 Upgrade your booking services, save time, and ensure hassle-free bookings.

🗓️ Booktics simplifies your online bookings, appointments, and events with unlimited bookings, multi-step booking wizard, multiple payment options, service management, dashboard reporting and many more.

It is suitable for service-based businesses and provides the ultimate booking solution in one place. With this booking plugin you can easily handle all types of booking services, including Tutoring Sessions, Dental Check-ups, Therapy Sessions, House Cleaning, Home Appliance Repairs, Hair Salon Appointments, Concert Ticket Booking and many more.

A few more helpful links here to get started👇

Documentation | Roadmaps

Need help setting up your booking calendar on your website? 👉 Let Us Know.

Booktics Booking System is Designed for Whom?

Booktics is made for service-based businesses. Whether you work alone or manage a team, Booktics booking calendar helps you stay organized and save time.

✅ Salons and Spas: Manage client bookings for hair, skin, and spa services easily.

✅ Dental and Clinics: Let patients book appointments with doctors or dentists online.

✅ Health and Wellness Centers: Streamline scheduling for therapy, massage, or wellness sessions.

✅ Cleaning Services: Allow customers to book home or office cleaning at their convenience.

✅ Fitness Trainers and Yoga Instructors: Schedule training sessions or group classes with ease.

✅ Repair and Maintenance Providers: Let customers book services like plumbing, electrical, or appliance repair.

✅ Beauty and Personal Care Businesses: Manage bookings for makeup, skincare, or grooming services smoothly.

Experience the Booking Features of Booktics

📅 Booking & Scheduling

Handle your booking and day-to-day scheduling tasks with ease.
Booktics helps you set up a smooth booking experience for your clients. Use our simple, step-by-step wizard to guide them through the process. Customize booking calendar views, add custom time slots, and set buffer times to avoid last-minute rush. You can limit how many bookings you accept and let clients reschedule or cancel with a few clicks. For events and group sessions, support multi-appointment bookings in one go.

  • Online Booking: Set up and manage bookings with real-time availability updates
  • Multi-Step Booking Wizard: Guide clients through the booking system in a clear, simple way.
  • Custom Time Slots: Offer flexible times for your services.
  • Buffer Time: Keep gaps between appointments to stay on schedule.
  • Booking Limits: Control how many bookings you take per slot.
  • Cancellation and Rescheduling: Let clients make changes as needed.

🛠️ Service Management

Run your services from one spot for better control.

Booktics makes it simple to add service details like length, price, and description, then manage them in clear categories.

  • Service Management: Set service details and group them for easy access.
  • Customizable Design Layout (coming soon): Match your form to your brand.
  • Extra Service: Allow users to add additional services during the main booking.
  • Group Booking: Enable users to book for a group, saving time.
  • Service Categories: Organize services into categories.
  • Multiple Pricing Durations: Add price variations based on service duration.

👥 Team Management

Handle team schedules and bookings with ease.

Team members get their own panel to manage appointments, and the Admin & Team Panel ensures everything runs smoothly.

  • Team Management: Manage team schedules and keep the booking calendar updated.
  • Admin Panel: Let your team handle bookings right from the frontend dashboard

👥 Customer and Order Management

Give your clients a great experience every step of the way.

Keep track of customer details, preferences, and booking history to make each appointment booking feel personal. Stay organized with all your orders and bookings in one dashboard. Create custom booking forms to get the details you need for every service.

  • Customer Management: Store client info and past booking details.
  • Orders: Track booking and payment statuses all in one place.
  • Booking Forms: Build forms to capture important info for each booking.

📊 Reporting & Analytics

Make better decisions with clear data on your booking system.

The Booktics dashboard gives you all the booking reports, revenue, and customer activity. Use these insights to improve your services and fill more slots in your booking calendar.

  • Dashboard & Reporting: See all your data in one dashboard.
  • Upcoming Bookings: See a list of upcoming bookings in this section.

💬 Notifications & Communication

Keep clients in the automation loop and cut down on no-shows.

Send booking confirmations, updates, and reminders via email. Additionally, automate the email options for more efficiency.

  • Email Notifications: Keep clients updated about their bookings.

🔒 Payment & Checkout

Get paid securely and easily.

Booktics connects with trusted payment gateways so clients can pay when they book. Use PayPal, Stripe, or WooCommerce to manage payments in your booking system.

  • PayPal Integration: Secure booking payments with PayPal (coming soon).
  • Stripe Integration: Accept cards and more in your booking system.
  • WooCommerce Payment Integration: Extend payments with WooCommerce (coming soon).

📅 Calendar & Sync

Stay organized across all your calendars.

The booking calendar view helps you see everything at once. Sync your booking system with Google Calendar,and Outlook,so you never double book.

  • Calendar View: Drag-and-drop booking management.
  • Calendar Sync: Keep your booking calendar in sync.
  • Google Calendar Integration: Sync with Google Calendar in real time.
  • Outlook Calendar Integration: Stay updated with Outloo.

🌐 Integrations & Automation

Connect with other apps to save time.

Use webhooks and tools like Zapier, FluentCRM, and Pabbly to automate tasks and make your appointment booking system even better.

  • FluentCRM Integration: Use customer data from your booking system.
  • Pabbly Integration: Automate tasks with your booking data (coming soon).
  • Zapier Integration: Connect your booking system to thousands of app (coming soon) .
  • Webhooks: Automate your work by linking your booking system to other tools (coming soon) .

Support and Documentation

📚 Simply visit our Documentation

💁 For any questions, ask them away on Booktics Support.

📝 Help us improve, input your valuable suggestions Booktics Roadmap

🙌 Join our All-Time Active Facebook Group

🎥 Learn actionable tutorials on Booktics YouTube Channel

So, why wait? 🚀 Get started in minutes – Just install, configure, and start accepting bookings

Now, What’s Next for You?

If you’re impressed with Booktics booking plugin, please check out our other awesome WordPress plugins:

📅 Eventin: All-in-one event management plugin for WordPress.

🍽️ WPCafe:Manage online Food Ordering, Restaurant Menu, Delivery, and Reservations.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/booktics directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. All Settings will be found in Admin sidebar -> Booktics
sections.faq:
Q: What is the main benefit of using this Booktics booking calendar?

A: This system makes booking easier across various sectors, such as clinics, education, salons, spas, sales and marketing, and customer support.

Q: Do I have to pay extra for add-ons?

A: There are no hidden fees, we promise! Booktics is the only WordPress booking plugin that provides premium add-ons completely free of charge.

Q: What kind of bookings can I manage?

A: From group bookings to online appointment booking.

Q: Does Booktics have recurring meeting features available?

A: Yes! Booktics offers recurring bookings and appointments; you can also set auto reminders.

Q: Does Booktics support multi-language translation?

A: Yes, you can easily translate your Booktics booking forms using the Loco Translate plugin, making your services accessible to a wider audience.
